tests.name: the unit suite is green on head, including the unchanged runtime, maintenance and admin tasks unit tests and the new admin read and spend totals unit tests; the new int tests in proc/cost-reconcile.int.test.ts, the extended proc/ended-job-reconcile.int.test.ts and the unchanged P11-02 int tests (processing, knowledge-repair, lesson-review-service, priv/media) run in CI test:int on the same head. AC-13 is traced to the cost-reconcile.int.test.ts tests for a hold from an earlier day or month (the cost row created_at equals the hold created_at, each cap counts it once, the real close time is recoverable, the meaning of closed_at is stated) and for a reconcile job whose authority is lost (nothing is closed and no row is written). AC-14 is traced, in branch (a), to the cost-reconcile.int.test.ts test for a run whose job_id became null through the real chain of job end, purge and pointer null; in branch (b), to the test or path:line the report names, with no code for that case. Root fix part (P12-01 card AC-15 to AC-25): a pass of TP-1 in the verify attestation covers the unit command only and claims no int run. The new int scenarios run in CI test:int on the same head, which contains the P12-06 auxiliary part from main, and are judged from that run (file, result, no skip) and the diff. They are in the new file packages/core/src/proc/continuation-owner.int.test.ts (written by the implementer, not locked by sha here); the "aux owner" names are in packages/core/src/proc/aux-continuation-owner.int.test.ts from P12-06. Each name is one exact, unique string literal in the diff (a test.each row is fine if it holds the full name) and appears exactly in the CI test:int output. Owner constraint 5 of E559, four proofs to stable names (AC-25 of the card writes every name in full; below, K stands for the kind written into the name): atomic ownership transfer: «continuation owner proc.process: zero-row pointer update commits no continuation and no checkpoint», «continuation owner proc.process: zombie with the same id and a stale lease writes nothing», and «aux owner K: zero-row pointer update commits no continuation and no checkpoint», «aux owner K: zombie with the same id and a stale lease writes nothing» for K = proc.capture_transcription and proc.voice_analysis; in-flight attempt: «in-flight K: provider waits, reconcile runs, the response arrives: one accounting and no wrong close» for K = proc.process, proc.capture_transcription and proc.voice_analysis; legacy state: «legacy null pointer proc.process: no takeover, no fail, no new attempt, no close for the ambiguity» and «aux owner K: legacy null pointer is not taken over» for the two auxiliary kinds; final combination: «final combination K: real reconcile keeps the live owner hold open, unownedOpen is 0, then the normal settle closes it» for the three kinds. Owner constraint 2 of E553, the main creator retry test: «continuation owner proc.process: retry after the continuation keeps the pointer» (AC-15, AC-17, AC-18). Also «continuation owner proc.process: J2 to J3 chain keeps the pointer on the live continuation» (AC-15, AC-18), «continuation owner proc.process: valid owner moves the pointer and still fails the run on a real error» (AC-18), and the F-8 guard «attempt guard K: a non-owner starts no provider attempt and closes no live hold» for the three kinds (AC-16, AC-17). Mapping: atomic transfer AC-15; in-flight AC-19; legacy AC-20; final combination AC-21 and AC-22. The added locked int tests (step-authority, capture-transcription, voice-processing) stay unchanged and green in the same CI run (AC-10). AC-23 and AC-24 are judged from the diff and the report
